notes.title: Missy's Bulletin #4: Mind Games
notes.notes:
Well, it's time to look onwards, to the future and what is to come next in [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]. With [i]The Second Tournament[/i], a lot of focus was put upon the physical facets of the game - new body types, new arenas, new hosts. The next order of priority is the less visible aspects of play - personality, sexuality, AI and mental transformation.

[i]The Third Tournament[/i] is the next vital step on the road to Kingdom Mode.

This update will be comparable to [i]The Second Tournament[/i] in scope, with many new features. Here's what is planned:
[list]
[*] [b]Personality Revamp[/b] - the existing personality system is being overhauled with a new system, based on the big five personality statistics. Personality will be gauged based on these and can change over the course of a game with transformation, and unique combinations of body, mind and soul will result in special personalities.
[*] [b]Sexuality and Gender[/b] - to go hand-in-hoof with the personality revamp, sexuality is being added. You can choose what your pawn is attracted to, what their gender is, seperate from their sex. If their sex and gender are different, then in Kingdom, they will be seriously unhappy and stressed. While this system won't affect Tournament Mode much, it is crucial in what is to come!
[*] [b]Improved AI Pathfinding[/b] - the current AI system is being upgraded with new pathfinding systems that will allow for pawns to travel in cramped conditions. This is vital for Kingdom, as buildings are a feature that is incoming beyond [i]The Third Tournament[/i].
[*] [b]Intelligence[/b] - pawns will be judged not just by their form but also the capabilities of their mind. Intelligence can be lowered and raised through transformation. This factors into the personality revamp and gameplay-wise, a pawn's ultimate fate will be decided by this even more than their body type. End a game with no intelligence, then you will enter Kingdom Mode as a brainless feral. Be careful!
[*] [b]Social, Allies and Rivals[/b] - pawns will be able to talk! As they go about their survival, you can overhear their mutterings, chants and threats to each other. You in addition, will be able to ask them to be allies, ask for help or warn them away. Allies can help you until there are no more contestants left, whilst enemies you make will be rivals, and hunt you down with fury and wrath.
[*] [b]New Insectoid Species[/b] - featuring bees, ants, butterflies and spiders! All new combinations of parts that will allow for dozens of new species! Buzz-buzz!
[*] [b]New Arena[/b] - a strange new arena, made of metal and with various containment chambers. What awaits you in the deep bowels of this hostile facility?
[*] [b]New Endings[/b] - the way games end will be revamped to lead more into Kingdom and your ultimate fate.
[*] [b]New Achievements[/b] - 21 new achievements, bringing the total to 63!
[*] [b]Much More![/b]
[/list]

These are all just what I've planned for [i]The Third Tournament[/i] - it's always possible for some to be moved to [i]The Fourth Tournament[/i] or cancelled outright if they do not work. We'll see.

[i]The Third Tournament[/i] is being worked on, but no date will be given until it is done. It'll be some weeks at least. I ask for patience as development continues.

It's gonna be something!

Until next time, stay in [i]her [/i]good graces!

- Jake

notes.title: Go Wild! The Second Tournament Begins!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]:[i] The Second Tournament[/i]! Featuring animal and tauric forms, new arenas, new hosts, new items, quests and instincts and so, so much more. The biggest update that [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i] has ever had up to this point. There's a lot to unpack, so here goes the changelog!

Changelog:

[b]New Arenas[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the arena system, allow for more maps other than the old one, which has retroactively been named Original Woods.
[*] Added four new arenas: Green Green Grasslands, Jivin' Jungle, Arctic Outlook and Ablaze Desert.
[*] Added the arena selection screen to the main menu.
[*] Upgraded the vegetation system to allow new plants and surface features for both the Original Woods arena and the four new ones.
[*] Upgraded the weather system to vary weather between arenas.
[/list]

[b]New Hosts[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the host system, allowing for hosts other than Missy to be in play. Each one offers new and exciting ways to play and new dangers to avert. Unlike Missy, each of these four can be influenced through various means.
[*] Added Ciba the Muscular. Ciba is a tough strongman who counts how many pawns you have knocked out of play. Increase your KO count to get on his good side!
[*] Added Kathiza of Lowes. Kathiza is a girl who likes treasure. When she asks for some, you better give! If you give an item of sufficient value, she can reward you!
[*] Added Lil' Buwddy. Buwddy's shy and kind and is only acting as host because her friend asked her to. You can refuse her punishments and rewards, but refuse too much, and the game will get a lot, lot harder! Don't say I didn't warn you.
[*] Added Mayor Leegross. Leegross is a king of rock 'n' roll and fancies himself a game show host. He'll quiz you on animal facts and if you get them right, your score goes up. The higher your score, the higher the stakes for punishment and reward!
[*] Added the four new host's character models into the game.
[*] Added the host selection screen to the main menu.
[*] Added voice samples for the new hosts.
[*] Gave Missy a makeover! She now sports a red-hot new hairdo and has bright white skin. This version of Missy has not replaced the old one - it is simply in storage. All future makeovers for Missy will work this way, too!
[*] Added the first dedicated outfits in-game, for use by the hosts for now, but in future, this feature will be expanded upon all pawns.
[/list]

[b]New Species[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several new body types that allow for various new species of animal. The three core types are humanoid, taur and feral. Humanoids retain a human shape, taurs have the lower body of an animal and ferals are completely animal in body structure. In addition, feral pawns cannot pick up items, lose all of their items upon transformation and must eat or use items upon the ground.
[*] Upgraded the existing sprites to include assets for the feral and taur species.
[*] Added several dozen new species to accompany the new body types.
[*] Added many new moves for the new species.
[/list]

[b]New Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added quests into the game. Quests are objectives that when completed, give you a specified reward. Quests are given by your host automatically upon an event.
[*] Added instincts into the game. Instincts are objectives that when completed, give you a specified reward. Instincts are biological missions that are given when you become a more inhuman species. When you complete an instinct, you automatically gain a new one.
[*] Changed the way the humanity value works. Now, when humanity is sufficiently low, you can be transformed into a feral pawn.
[*] Added Tauric Body moves, special moves for Taur pawns that replace the leg, tail and special moves.
[*] Added Feral Body moves, special moves for Feral pawns that replace the five traditional moves.
[*] Added restrictor to the inventory, preventing Feral pawns from ever having items in their inventory, even through host events.
[*] Added Misshekels, the currency of Missy's Kingdom, into the game. At the moment, these can only be spent on vending machines, but when Missy's Kingdom as a mode comes, this currency will be vital in your pawn's everyday life, so save up! You gain Misshekels through the in-game chests - the amount of Misshekels inside are automatically pocketed upon opening.
[*] Added vending machines to the game. You can vend items by general rarity with a fixed cost of Misshekels - 250 for common, 500 for uncommon, 1000 for rare, 1500, for very rare, 2000 for legendary.
[*] Changed inventory so that inventory is stored with pawn data, instead of via a common storage, so each pawn has a designated inventory unique to them.
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Added various new fruits, vegetables and foods to the various new maps.
[*] Some items previously in Original Woods have been moved to the various new maps.
[*] Added Mythic Juice - a rare item that can transform you into one of the super-rare mythical humanoid species.
[*] Added Super-U Pen - a super-rare item that can transform you into any of the existing species in the game.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 21 new achievements.
[*] Added many new passwords for the Velvet Deluxe Pass - see the guide for details.
[*] Added the new The Second Tournament version of the game's logo to the main menu.
[*] Put the old First Tournament message into storage and replaced it with a new one detailing the features to come in The Third Tournament.
[*] Added cave background to the main menu.
[*] Various spelling fixes.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a menu switch bug whereby clicking on the top right menu button and then pressing one of the stat buttons causes an inability to press the menu button for the reminder of the game.
[*] Fixed a glitch with specific pawn select menu buttons being too small to click.
[*] Various other bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] The 'Hopper Rising' move gives hedgehog transformations instead of rabbit.
[/list]

If you feel this work deserves to continue, feel free to purchase the Velvet Deluxe Pass if you haven't already for an expanded experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1219440/
I appreciate all the support I get!

The ultimate goal of all this is to create the greatest transformation game ever made, with two key parts: a Tournament mode, in which you get transformed, and Kingdom mode, in which you must live with your changes. Kingdom mode is not made yet and requires a lot of stuff to happen before work on it can begin. However, with [i]The Second Tournament[/i] complete, we are one massive step there!

Next, after a settling week or so of receiving feedback, work on [i]The Third Tournament[/i] shall begin, focusing on a personality revamp, mental transformation, traits, social conversations, rivalries and alliances between contestants, a new group of animals for transformations and much more. The next update will be the last update before work on Missy's Kingdom, the life-sim, shall begin, in [i]The Fourth Tournament[/i].

Until next time! Have fun and kick butt!

Because you all rock!

Thank you!

- Jake

notes.title: Missy's Bulletin #3: Beyond Human
notes.notes:
The day is coming. The day of renewal. The day of change. The day of transformation.

[i]The Second Tournament[/i] is coming very soon!

This update will be massive - the largest [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i] has ever received up to this point. Themed around 'Wild', [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i] will add many features that will magnify the replayability and fun of the game, with new modes, arenas, gameplay mechanics and much more!

The features to come in [i]The Second Tournament[/i] include:
[list]
[*] [b]Ferals and Taurs[/b] - no longer are transformations limited to humanoid forms! Now, transform and be transformed into full animal feral shapes and half-and-half tauric shapes! This will come with dozens and dozens of new species alongside with new moves, gameplay features and transformations.
[*] [b]New Arenas[/b] - no longer are you in a single arena! Four new arenas have emerged to wage transformative war in! With five different arenas, each with unique events, items and transformations, you can fight from sand to soil to rock to snow!
[*] [b]New Hosts[/b] - Missy takes a step back to allow her Champions to take centre-stage! Ciba, Kathiza, Buwddy and Leegross can now host a tournament in addition to Missy, each one with unique mechanics that offer great reward for the fortunate and brave. However, their punishments can be even more severe than Missy's. Be careful!
[*] [b]New Game Modes[/b] - in addition to the traditional game mode, two new modes expand how you play: Quickfire and Marathon. Quickfire Mode is a fast-paced tournament with quick transformations, more brutal punishments and less time between events. Marathon Mode is an endurance tournament, with fewer visits by your host and slower transformations - can you survive a full match?
[*] [b]Quests and Instincts[/b] - during tournaments, you can receive quests from your host and small instincts from within your transformed mind. Satisfy these quests and instincts for rewards across your tournament to boost your chances for victory!
[*] [b]Pawn-Specific Inventories[/b] - each of your pawns and champions will have their own stored inventory, independent of each other.
[*] [b]New Achievements[/b] - 21 new achievements, bringing the total to 42!
[*] [b]Much More![/b]
[/list]

These are in addition to the various tweaks and bug fixes that have been logged.

For those wondering - traits have been moved to [i]The Third Tournament[/i] for a variety of reasons. They're coming, but not now. Many would rely on mechanics to be introduced in the future, so it makes more sense to hold off of them for now.

More details will come as the release date comes a-rolling.

The Second Tournament is likely to release before or on the end of this month, July. However, this is subject to change if issues arise.

[i][b]UPDATE[/b]: As of 30th July, The Second Tournament is complete and is undergoing testing before release. The release date is delayed by one additional week to accommodate this, so The Second Tournament will release by August 7th.[/i]

Until next time, stay in [i]her [/i]good graces!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 6
notes.notes:
Welcome to the final update to[i] The First Tournament[/i] of [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]! This one features several things, but chiefest among them is the archived fates viewer, allowing you to see all the pawns that fell across all of your stored past games. In addition there is a new type of transformation - Erinacine, which constitutes Hedgehogs, Porcupines and Echidnas as new species - the first of many new species that I hope to add in the future.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Added the archived fates viewer, allowing for the viewing of the entire backlog of characters stored from your previous games. These are the characters that will be imported when Kingdom mode comes, along with the ability to vet which ones are imported when Kingdom comes. For now, you can simply view them, both pre and after tournament, but all their data is ready to go!
[*] Added item drops for fallen contestants - contestants will now drop some of their inventory upon defeat, to the ground. This happens both when you defeat a contestant and when contestants defeat one another, so expect more items than normal, both rare and common. As the game progresses, you can expect the quality/rarity of these drops to be greater, as pawns collect more and more stuff.
[*] Added the Erinacine DNA type and the new Hedgehog, Porcupine and Echidna species into the various aspects of the game. Featuring spines on their head, these species can do a lot of damage! (As a note, this is the first DNA type that is not based on a real one - these species are very separate biologically in life).
[*] Added the Spinefruit item into the game, fitting into the trend of uncommon items that cause transformations.
[*] Added the new species transformations to the various transformatives methods that already exist, such as New-U and Missy's events.
[*] Added new moves for the new species and parts, with one, Echidning, being the first move that can transform into another move.
[*] Added various new encyclopedia pages for the newly introduced species and item.
[*] Fixed a bug wherein the Elephant species wouldn't update properly when transforming.
[*] Fixed the misnamed Andrabsinthe page in the encyclopedia.
[*] Fixed several small bug fixes to some transformation mechanics.
[/list]

Alas, [i]The First Tournament[/i] is almost over. It will continue only until the next begins in July.

Work on the features exclusive to [i]The Second Tournament[/i] is now the priority, featuring feral and tauric forms, new arenas with an arena select screen and many new ways to transform and be transformed. Alongside this will be many changes - Missy will look different, unseen characters will take to the stage and the first story content will rise.

It's [i][b]wild[/b][/i] and it's only going to get [b][i]wilder[/i][/b] from here on out!

[i]The First Tournament[/i] was experimental, with feedback allowing it to be more fun, more exciting and more stable than it ever could be.

[i]The First Tournament[/i] was about establishing the gameplay, the world and the mechanics. From now on, each Tournament will be themed, with related additions bundled and worked on together, much like how expansions are made for games.

Therefore, there will be no gameplay-adding updates until [i]The Second Tournament[/i] launches, sometime in July.

[i]The Second Tournament[/i] will be about the [u][b]wild[/b][/u]. The wilderness of the arenas, the pure animal forms of feral pawns and biological traits of transformed bodies. That's the focus for [i]The Second Tournament[/i], but of course, that's not all that's being worked on.

Stay tuned for more details as they solidify.

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 5
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next gameplay-adding update to [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]! This one features a really big feature that has been in the works for a while: an in-game encyclopedia, among other things, including tutorials and several data-based changes.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Added an in-game encyclopedia, accessible on the menu in-game and on the main menu outside of a tournament. Pages have to be unlocked - by turning into a species or clicking on a NPC to unlock the associated species page, by having an item in your inventory for item pages and through various data points in a tournament for everything else.
[*] Added over 150 pages in the encyclopedia across 7 categories.
[*] Added a index for the encyclopedia, to sort through the many pages across the categories.
[*] Added twelve in-game tutorial screens to appear at various points of a player's tournament mode career.
[*] Added the ability to view all tutorials outside of a game on the main menu, outside of a tournament.
[*] Made the tutorial button in the options work with the new tutorial system - turn it off and on to toggle tutorials in-game.
[*] Added the ability to view unlocked pages of the encyclopedia outside of a game on the main menu.
[*] Added a info button on the main menu for accessing the encyclopedia and tutorials.
[*] Added a script to unlock pages for currently inaccessible species.
[*] Added data points as a new object in tournament mode. Click on them to have a chance to unlock a new encyclopedia page. Around 20 will spawn per tournament.
[*] Added minutes points, similar to data points, but specific to unlocking Missy's Minutes pages. Around 4 will spawn her tournament.
[*] The game will now store tutorial and encyclopedia page data in the game's save folder, persistent across all games.
[*] Added under-the-hood support for more characters in the game's data, as well as future clothing options for the upcoming Missy's Kingdom mode.
[*] Made homonine tails to be invisible, like a human's
[/list]

More pages will come in future updates, as well as additions to the currently existing pages, especially the Places and Lore categories.

Next, I plan to work on the archived fates viewer and various little additions. The next version, Version 6, will be the last version of [i]The First Tournament[/i] to be released.

After that, well... you best prepare for [i]The Second Tournament[/i].

Because things are going to get [i][b]wild[/b][/i]!

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 4
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first gameplay-adding update to [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]! This one has a lot of things, but the principal feature is skin types - an entire new body part to transform!

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Add skin types into the game. Currently, these are bare skin, fur, scales, feathers and wool, with support for more in the future.
[*] Added the ability to delete champions.
[*] Expanded the scope of the sex system - now, the symbol on your character screen will change depending on your body configuration.
[*] Two new sexes have been added - intersex (for those that are not strictly male or female) and null (no sex). These can happen during a game's transformations.
[*] Made the transformations of pawns unto other pawns more powerful, so you'll see more pure morphs during the course of a game.
[*] Added a new item: the Skinchanger, into the game. Skinchangers can be found in common chests and change only your skin type.
[*] Added humanity losses to traps and effect zones.
[*] Added a cheat notification for the Velvet Deluxe Pass' cheat screen. This will let you know if your game is eligible for leaderboards. Using cheats or passwords will trigger your game to be 'cheated'.
[*] Added a limit to the archived fates - for the moment, the limit is 50,000.
[*] Added two new passwords to the Velvet Deluxe Pass' passwords system - MISSYSUCKS will trigger an event whilst FORECASTER will change the weather.
[*] Added a skin type selector into the Velvet Deluxe Pass' enhanced character creator.
[*] Changed the turtle torso by taking the shell and making it the first in a new kind of body part - back placeables. This also fixes some of the overlap it had previously.
[*] Updated all transformations to include skin types.
[*] Removed wool from the sheep torso sprite and converted its sprite into the new skin type mechanic.
[*] Fixed a bug where trunks of elephant-morphs appeared under male pawn's beards.
[*] Fixed the diet text in the character screen - it will now be accurate to your form.
[*] Added some more subheaders for the title screen.
[/list]

A quick note: the sprites for the skin types will likely be tweaked in the coming days and weeks to better fit all combinations of body types.

Next, I plan to work on the tutorials and the in-game encyclopedia - to make understanding the game and its world a whole lot smoother.

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Missy's Bulletin #2: Post-Release Plans
notes.notes:
Well the release week has come and gone and what a week it was! A lot of feedback has been received and logged - thanks to everyone for your supporting words!

Already Version 3 of [i]The First Tournament[/i] as been released, addressing some of the most important issues brought up. However, there are a good deal more that I would like to see done before [i]The Second Tournament[/i] comes out.

That is what June's updates will be about.

Here's a list of what you can expect to see added by the end of this month. Bare in mind, some of these may be expanded and/or moved to a later update as development continues:

[list]
[*] [b]Archived fates viewer[/b] - so you can view pawns in all your past games
[*] [b]New sex mechanics[/b] - additional in-between sexes will be added so your character will gradually have their sex symbol changed throughout the game
[*] [b]More powerful transformations[/b] - NPC pawns will be able to dish out more powerful transformations as the game progresses
[*] [b]Tutorials[/b] - a comprehensive in-game guide to playing [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament [/i]through in-game tips and instructions
[*] [b]Hedgehogs, Porcupines and Echidnas[/b] - a new genus of animal to transform into and transform others into! Featuring prickly spines and pointy attacks!
[*] [b]Skin types[/b] - skin will be able to be transformed from standard bare skin to fur, scales and feathers. Features additional textures and colours based on your hair.
[*] [b]In-game encyclopedia[/b] - the beginnings of an in-game source of lore, glancing into the world of [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i].
[/list]

These are in addition to the various tweaks and bug fixes that have been logged.

The first new Version will come sometime in the middle of this month and these features will come in waves instead of all at once.

Also, bare in mind that if one or more of these features are particularly troublesome, they may be worked on and/or moved into next month. We'll see, though!

More details will come as the Versions come a-rolling.

Until next time, stay in [i]her [/i]good graces!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 3
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to address some balance issues and needed features. There'll more the coming weeks, but these are the most pressing.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Increased the amount of thirst that water bottles and few other hydrating items restore, so you need to drink less
[*] Made NPC pawns more aggressive by a factor of two, on average
[*] Added the ability to cancel a move by right-clicking with the mouse
[*] Decreased the speed of hunger depletion, so it goes down slower
[*] Decreased the speed of thirst depletion, so it goes down slower
[*] Decreased the player's movement speed slightly
[*] Added humanity losses to most transformative items, so that they decrease your humanity meter slightly with each use
[*] Fixed some minor errors in Missy's events
[/list]

The next update will focus on new features - look forward to it in Early June!

See you then!

- Jake

notes.title: Missy's Bulletin #1: The Road to Kingdom
notes.notes:
[i]Welcome to Missy's Transformation Tournament![/i]

Or more specifically, welcome to [i]The First Tournament[/i] of [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]!

This is a game about change. At the moment, only the process of change and transformation is featured, however, in the long run, [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i] will feature content and gameplay concerning post-transformation and living with the changes your pawns have received in their tournaments.

Ah, but I'm getting ahead of myself! Before we get to that point, I'd like to discuss the updates to [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i] that are in the works on the road to that.

Basically, each update will be sequential, so the next and first big update will be [i]The Second Tournament[/i].

[u][b][i]The Second Tournament[/i] [/b][/u] - Early Summer 2020

[i]The Second Tournament[/i] will focus on expanding the number of forms the pawns can have by adding [b]tauric bodies, like centaurs, and feral forms[/b]. Feral forms are pure animal forms that are the result of being transformed whilst having low humanity or through certain rare means. This means that pawns will be able to have animal lower-halves or be entirely animal, in addition to the standard human shape.

Another thing in [i]The Second Tournament[/i] is the addition of an [b]arena selection [/b]screen and some [b]new arenas[/b], to spice up gameplay! Alongside this will be new items, preferences and and the addition of [b]traits [/b]and [b]quests[/b] for contestants to complete for rewards.

There will be mini-updates in-between to account for tweaks, balances issues and quality-of-life enhancements.

[u][b][i]The Third Tournament[/i][/b][/u]  - Late Summer 2020

After [i]The Second Tournament[/i], [i]The Third Tournament[/i] will focus on expanding every aspect of play, as well as adding many [b]new species and transformations[/b]. 

This will come with the ability to[b] talk[/b] to and [b]hear the words of other contestants[/b], as well as a [b]rivalry [/b]system for the tournament.

After this update, work will begin of a new mode to [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]. That mode is...

[h3][u][b]Missy's Kingdom[/b][/u][/h3] - Autumn/Fall 2020

Expanding on the mechanics of the current fates system, [i]Missy's Kingdom[/i] will be a life-simulator, following the [b]tale of your pawn[/b], from the end of their tournament, whether they won or lost. 

They will enter Missy's Kingdom and be assigned a job in one of the sectors of her society. Among you are the many pawns of Missy that have been through their own tournaments. [b]All are changed. All are different[/b].

You will play in a more peaceful world where the only goal is to advance the ranks of society, or find a mate and start a family, or try to get back at Missy for transforming you.

This mode will start simple and have new jobs, features and events in subsequent updates, just like the Tournament mode proper!

That's the immediate future for [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]!

There's a lot more to cover - dozens of new species, new items and new features, but these will be covered when they come.

When Kingdom comes, your fate will be made manifest. For Missy is kind and good and you? You belong to [i]her[/i]!

Thank you for reading and enjoy [i]Missy's Transformation Tournament[/i]!

- Jake
